table.title: Social discount rate
table.meaning: social discount rate applied to every monthly flow

table.title: Harm valuation multiplier
table.meaning: scales the monetised harm of incidents; 1.0 takes the engine's damages at face value

table.title: Consumer surplus base
table.meaning: annual consumer surplus from AI services at the starting level of capability and reach

table.title: Consumer surplus elasticity
table.meaning: proportional change in consumer surplus per proportional change in the AI service index

table.title: Output uplift base
table.meaning: annual output uplift attributable to AI adoption at the starting service index

table.title: Output uplift elasticity
table.meaning: proportional change in the output uplift per proportional change in the service index

table.title: Trust elasticity of adoption benefits
table.meaning: proportional change in realised adoption benefits per proportional change in public trust

table.title: Overlap of the output uplift with other benefits
table.meaning: share of the output uplift already counted as consumer surplus or as the AI firms' own profit, removed from the output uplift; 0 takes the three benefit components as defined, without overlap

table.title: Resource share of compliance spend
table.meaning: share of compliance spend that is a real resource cost rather than a transfer

table.title: Enforcement cost
table.unit: $bn a year per unit of capacity
table.meaning: public budget consumed by one unit of enforcement capacity

table.title: Value lost per dollar moved offshore
table.meaning: domestic value added lost per dollar of revenue whose activity moves offshore

table.title: Labour adjustment cost
table.meaning: short run adjustment cost per point of growth in the AI service index (displacement, retraining)

table.title: Resident ownership share
table.meaning: share of the firms' operating profit that accrues to residents and counts in national welfare

table.title: Resource share of the insurance loading
table.meaning: share of the insurance loading that is a real resource cost (underwriting, administration) rather than a transfer to insurers

table.title: Misuse incident rate
table.meaning: monthly rate of a reportable misuse incident for a firm at capability 1, full reach and no safety practice

table.title: Accident rate
table.meaning: the same for accidents and failures

table.title: Systemic incident rate
table.meaning: the same for systemic incidents (markets, infrastructure, information)

table.title: Capability elasticity of incidents
table.meaning: incident rate scales with capability to this power

table.title: Safety elasticity of incidents
table.meaning: incident rate falls as exp(-elasticity x safety level)

table.title: Reach elasticity of incidents
table.meaning: incident rate scales with deployment reach to this power

table.title: Offshore laxity
table.meaning: extra incident rate on activity moved offshore, relative to home

table.title: Median harm of a misuse incident
table.meaning: median monetised harm of a misuse incident

table.title: Median harm of an accident
table.meaning: median monetised harm of an accident

table.title: Median harm of a systemic incident
table.meaning: median monetised harm of a systemic incident

table.title: Dispersion of incident harm
table.meaning: lognormal dispersion of incident harm (heavy tail)

table.title: Major incident threshold
table.meaning: harm above which an incident counts as major

table.title: Monthly catastrophe probability
table.meaning: monthly probability of a catastrophic incident for a firm above critical capability with no safety practice

table.title: Critical capability
table.meaning: capability above which the catastrophic tail is live

table.title: Median harm of a catastrophe
table.meaning: median monetised harm of a catastrophic incident

table.title: Share of incidents an evaluation could catch
table.meaning: share of the incident rate attributable to releases an evaluation could catch

table.title: Dispersion of catastrophic harm
table.meaning: lognormal dispersion of catastrophic harm around its median

table.title: Correlation of catastrophes across firms
table.meaning: correlation of catastrophic failures across firms within a month (one factor Gaussian copula): shared models, components and vulnerabilities; 0 makes the firms' catastrophes independent given the state

table.title: Misuse multiplier for open weights
table.meaning: misuse rate of a developer that publishes weights, relative to one that does not

table.title: Capability growth
table.meaning: monthly log growth of the capability index when all R&D goes to capability (a doubling in about 30 months)

table.title: Safety learning rate
table.meaning: monthly gain in safety practice at saturation; the gain is a x share/(share + 0.1), diminishing in the share

table.title: Growth fade time
table.meaning: time constant over which a firm's growth fades towards the long run rate

table.title: Safety spend that displaces capability R&D
table.meaning: share of safety spend that displaces capability R&D (the rest is additional budget or spills over)

table.title: Chip growth lost to export controls
table.meaning: annual revenue growth lost by the chip sector under full export controls

table.title: Long run growth
table.meaning: the growth rate firms fade towards

table.title: Safety decay
table.meaning: monthly erosion of safety practice without investment

table.title: Revenue response to capability
table.meaning: revenue growth per unit of log capability growth

table.title: Revenue response to reach
table.meaning: revenue relative to the frictionless, full trust reach path, to this power

table.title: Reach adjustment speed
table.meaning: speed at which reach closes on its capability and trust determined ceiling

table.title: Weight firms put on growth
table.meaning: how a firm values a year of extra growth against a year of cost

table.title: Relocation cost
table.meaning: one off cost of moving a unit of activity offshore

table.title: Revenue lost offshore
table.meaning: revenue lost per unit of activity offshore (talent, customers, latency)

table.title: Firm risk aversion
table.meaning: weight on the variance of expected liability in the firm's choice

table.title: Firm optimism about incidents
table.meaning: the share of its true incident rate a firm believes when it plans

table.title: Audit rate
table.meaning: probability a firm in scope is audited in a month at capacity 1

table.title: Insurance loading
table.meaning: premium above expected liability charged by insurers under a mandate

table.title: Safe harbour shield
table.meaning: share of liability a compliant firm avoids under a safe harbour

table.title: Research slowdown under a moratorium
table.meaning: share of capability growth lost by a firm in scope while a moratorium holds

table.title: Weight of safety culture
table.meaning: value a firm places on a unit gain in safety practice per unit of revenue, multiplied by its culture score

table.title: Reach ceiling saturation
table.meaning: speed at which the reach ceiling 1 - exp(-k C) saturates in capability

table.title: Growth lost to an open weights restriction
table.meaning: annual revenue growth lost by an open weights developer while publishing is restricted

table.title: Enforcement response speed
table.meaning: speed at which enforcement intensity follows public pressure

table.title: Trust recovery
table.meaning: monthly recovery of public trust towards 1

table.title: Trust sensitivity to harm
table.meaning: fall in trust per unit of log monetised harm in a month

table.title: News memory
table.meaning: persistence of the news pressure index

table.title: Salience boost from mandatory reporting
table.meaning: extra salience of incidents when reporting is mandatory

table.title: Market volatility
table.meaning: volatility of the common market factor

table.title: Sentiment persistence
table.meaning: persistence of the price's non fundamental component

table.title: Price impact of news pressure
table.meaning: price impact of a unit of news pressure on an exposed firm

table.title: Price jump on an own incident
table.meaning: own incident price jump per log unit of harm relative to revenue

table.title: Sector contagion
table.meaning: share of an own incident jump felt by the rest of the sector

table.title: Announcement price impact
table.meaning: price reaction at announcement per unit of expected compliance cost over earnings

table.title: Chip demand coupling
table.meaning: chip and cloud revenue growth per unit of model developers' capability growth

table.title: Open weights diffusion
table.meaning: capability spillover from published weights to the rest of the economy
